description: Use projection:'component-library' for the unified source-free library page, returned as complete JSON with exact scoped definition/preset/recipe cards and pagination. Choose origin:'builtin' for the maintained builtins or origin:'library' for the authenticated serving home; use libraryKind, category, q, limit and after to filter/page. Preserve each card identity.scope and identity.revision, its source/definition pin or exact recipe document identity; same names/IDs in different scopes remain distinct. Resolve the selected exact source with sourceVersionId (plus builtinCollection for an explicitly selected builtin), never a latest-head or another-home lookup. Presets identify their exact presetVersionId, definition pin and historical document witness; recipes identify their complete exact document and member source pins. This projection contains no source bodies or legacy thumbnail substitution. Omit projection for the historical catalog protocol below. DISCOVER WHAT TO BUILD WITH — list the component catalog: the one built-in primitive (heroText, the behind-subject overlay) plus your org-installed components. Desktop also includes bundled kind:'component-package' entries: these are complete reusable authored packages; insert them with the desktop apply_template tool using placement.template and explicit insert.startTime/idPrefix, media bindings and parameter values. Do not pass their ids to clip.add, get_component_source, or cueframe://component resources. Their draft status does not certify visual review or licensing. For hosted builtin preset/recipe cards, call resolve_builtin_component with the exact collection, id and revision, then apply_template with template:<builtin id> and body:{projectId,documentSha256,insert:{startTime,idPrefix},...}. Hosted tool request fields live under body; desktop tool shapes may differ. The agent-safe default page is 20 entries; use pagination.nextCursor as `after`, or narrow with category, kind, tier, useCase, mood, q, or intent. Results are recommended-tier-first when filtered. Primitive/installed entries carry the exact placement hint for apply_composition and fixedCopy warnings; use get_component_source to fork a primitive when baked copy must change. Read cueframe://component/{id} for the full primitive/installed prop schema. SCENE SHOTS ARE NOT LISTED HERE: there is no built-in scene primitive, so do not look for one — author a shot with the scene.add op (see cueframe://scene-shot). The wrapper it registers then appears here as an ordinary INSTALLED component under these same rules.

after.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor (forward-only).

intent.description: Alias of `q` framed as recommend-by-intent (e.g. intent=intro). Recommend-orders results.

limit.description: Page size (1..100). Omit to return the whole filtered catalog in one page.

mood.description: Filter to entries whose mood tags include this value (e.g. cinematic, minimal).

origin.description: With component-library projection, builtin selects immutable builtin cards; library selects the authenticated org's exact serving datastore.

useCase.description: Filter to entries whose useCase includes this edit role (e.g. intro, title-over-footage, grade).
